project.recovered_toast: Restored as a separate copy. Save asks for a new name; the damaged file stays as it is.
project.unsaved.title: Save changes to “{name}”?
project.unsaved.body: Your changes will be lost if you don't save them.
project.locked.title: File in use
project.locked.body: “{name}” is already open in another OpenConstructionDesign window. You can open it read-only and save your changes under another name.
project.locked_save.body: “{name}” is open in another OpenConstructionDesign window, so it can't be written. Close it there or choose another name.
project.newer.title: File from a newer version
project.newer.body: This project was saved by a newer version of OpenConstructionDesign (format {found}, this version reads up to {supported}). Update the program to open it. The file was not changed.
project.damaged.title: File is damaged
project.damaged.body: The project could not be read: {detail}. The file was not changed.
project.damaged.prev: Previous copy: {name}, saved {date}. It opens read-only; Save will ask for a new name.
project.damaged.none: No previous copy or autosave snapshot of this project was found.
project.prefs_not_saved: Settings are not being saved: {why}. They stay until you close the program.
project.not_project.title: Not a project file
project.not_project.body: This file is not a OpenConstructionDesign project. Drawings and models in other formats open through Import.
project.open_failed.title: Project not opened
project.open_failed.body: The project could not be opened: {detail}. The current model was not changed.
project.save_failed.title: Project not saved
project.save_failed.body: The file could not be written: {detail}. The previous file is unchanged and your edits are still here. Free up disk space or choose another folder.
project.upgraded: Project upgraded to the current format. Previous version of the file: {backup}
project.upgraded_ro: Project upgraded to the current format in the working copy. The file was not changed.
project.read_only_toast: Opened read-only: Save will ask for a new name
project.orphans.title: A working copy was kept
project.orphans.body: After the crash, a working copy of your edits could not be turned into an autosave snapshot, for example because the disk is full. Nothing was deleted: the copy is in “{folder}”. It is a project file: copy it elsewhere with the .ddc extension and open it.
project.orphans.stranded_title: Part of a working copy was moved apart
